status.current: defeated and recaptured by Ayase Ayatsuji

relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: Old enemy who defeated his gang but forgot him entirely.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Opponent who captures him during his revenge attack.

periods.summary: Okuma escapes during the nationwide prison-break chaos and attacks Ayatsuji dojo to avenge his Senzan-gumi gang, which Kaito destroyed fifteen years earlier. Because Kaito does not remember him, Okuma becomes enraged and attacks with wind-pressure punches and anti-Ayatsuji tactics he prepared in prison. Ayase overcomes Windburst Barrier and Claw Storm with Ten'i Muhou and Hidzume, expanding a shallow wound into a disabling slash.

key_events.summary: Attacks the dojo for revenge but is defeated by Ayase.
